title: World Cup: Spain's homecoming heroes
summary: A nation celebrates as Spain's World Cup champions come home to a hero's welcome.
full_text:
World Cup: Spain's homecoming heroes
A nation celebrates as Spain's World Cup champions come home to a hero's welcome.
JUANA SUMMERS, HOST:
Spain's World Cup champions are celebrating back home, parading through the streets of Madrid after a hard-fought 1-0 victory over Argentina. NPR's Miguel Macias reports.
(SOUNDBITE OF MUSIC)
MIGUEL MACIAS, BYLINE: For fans lining the streets of Madrid today, this celebration was worth the wait. For Merce Moron, today's celebration also brings back a very different memory.
MERCE MORON: (Speaking Spanish).
MACIAS: 1986, the World Cup in Mexico, quarterfinals against Belgium, a missed penalty kick by Spain.
MORON: (Speaking Spanish).
MACIAS: Moron says she and her brother stood on their balcony and cried. She later told her father...
MORON: (Speaking Spanish).
MACIAS: "I will never see Spain win a World Cup 'cause Spain is never going to win a World Cup." Moron was speaking for many Spaniards who, for generations, went from heartbreak to heartbreak. The world's biggest stars came to play in Spain, Barcelona, Real Madrid. The football was spectacular, but the national team always seemed to fall short. But then things changed. Spain's golden generation won back-to-back Euros and the 2010 World Cup in South Africa. And then last night, Argentina's goalie, Emiliano Dibu Martinez, had a record 11 saves, much to the frustration of the Spanish fans who could not breathe easy until the game was finally over.
UNIDENTIFIED CROWD: (Chanting in Spanish).
MACIAS: Merce Moron watched the game with her family, as many Spaniards did. After the game, she was emotional.
MORON: (Speaking Spanish).
MACIAS: "I never imagined I could live to witness two World Cups, two finals, two wins. I have goose bumps. I've cried so much."
Ruben Jimenez did not mind getting up early this morning for his job at a bank.
RUBEN JIMENEZ: (Speaking Spanish).
MACIAS: "How wonderful it is to wake up a world champion," Jimenez says. He says what he admired the most about this Spanish team was not one individual player, but the team itself.
JIMENEZ: (Speaking Spanish).
MACIAS: The team that doesn't rely on any stars and doesn't wait for a superstar to save the day. And Spain's future looks just as promising. Young players like Lamine Yamal, Nico Williams and Pedri are expected to be entering their prime by the next World Cup in 2030. The hosts - Morocco, Portugal and Spain.
Miguel Macias, NPR News, Spain.
(SOUNDBITE OF SHAKIRA AND BURNA BOY SONG, "DAI DAI")

title: Japan says Chinese and Russian warships held live-fire drills within its EEZ
summary:
Chinese and Russian navy ships were spotted conducting joint live-fire drills within Japan’s claimed exclusive economic zone in the Pacific Ocean on Sunday, its defence ministry said.
Japanese Defence Minister Shinjiro Koizumi first revealed that the two navies had held drills in Japan’s EEZ during an address to the Farnborough International Airshow in Britain on Monday, highlighting their deepening military cooperation, according to media reports.
Japan’s defence ministry later confirmed that...
full_text:
Japan says Chinese and Russian warships held live-fire drills within its EEZ
Japanese defence ministry confirms the navy vessels were spotted in the Pacific, southwest of the remote Okinotori Island
Japan’s defence ministry later confirmed that two Chinese missile destroyers and a Chinese supply ship had been detected with a Russian frigate about 330km (205 miles) southwest of the remote Okinotori Island, sailing northeastward.
One of the Chinese destroyers was later confirmed to have conducted an exercise about 180km southwest of the island and within Japan’s claimed EEZ while the Russian frigate was nearby, according to the ministry.
It said the Chinese warship’s crew had notified ships in surrounding waters of the location and duration of the drill.
Okinotori is a coral atoll located in the Philippine Sea about 1,740 km south of Tokyo. At high tide it consists of just two tiny rocks above water – insufficient to claim its surrounding waters as part of an EEZ under international law.

title: To prosper, China must become a magnet for international students
summary:
Last month, 12.9 million students in China sat for the National Higher Education Entrance Examination, or gaokao, the number sliding for a second year, and down from 13.3 million last year. Given that births have fallen below 8 million annually to a record low, in 18 years, the country’s more than 3,100 universities will find themselves fighting over an even smaller cohort.
This will coincide with a growing global competition for talent. In a knowledge-driven economy, the countries that prosper...
full_text:
To prosper, China must become a magnet for international students
China must seize the opportunity to become a global education hub. Reform of its universities should begin now
The global fertility rate has fallen from 2.9 births per woman in 1994 to 2.2 in 2024, and more than half of all countries and territories are now below the replacement level of 2.1. Even where fertility remains comparatively high, the direction is unmistakable: around one-third of all countries and territories had fertility rates of four or higher in 1994 but this had dropped to just 13 per cent in 2024.
This transition is reaching countries once regarded as bastions of demographic growth. Take Bangladesh for example. Its fertility rate fell from 6.7 births per woman in 1960 to 2.2 in 2013 and has hovered around the replacement level since. As a region, South Asia’s fertility rate stood at 2.0 in 2024. Even sub-Saharan Africa, the world’s youngest and fastest-growing region, has experienced a sustained decline.
While the world will not suddenly run out of young people, the distribution of talent will become increasingly important. Countries that can educate and offer opportunities to talented individuals will be better positioned to shape the future.
International students will become a critical component of the global talent competition. For decades, the United States and Europe benefited as major destinations for talent. Their universities attracted generations of students who later became researchers, entrepreneurs, skilled professionals and bridges between societies. Students entering the classroom today are not just participants of academic exchange, they are building the talent networks that shape tomorrow’s economy.

title: NSW land-clearing up 16% in 2024 as conservation groups say Minns government failing to rein in habitat loss
summary:
Decline in clearing of trees and shrubs offset by sharp jump in clearing of non-woody vegetation

  • Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates

  • Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast

Almost 90 rugby league fields’ worth of woody habitat were bulldozed in New South Wales every day in 2024, according to new government data which shows the state has failed to rein in high rates of clearing.

Clearing of vegetation across the state increased by 16% in 2024, reaching 81,293 hectares (200,879 acres) in total – an area more than 275 times the size of the Sydney CBD. The increase was due to a sharp jump in clearing of non-woody vegetation, up 70% on the previous year.

Continue reading...
full_text:
Almost 90 rugby league fields’ worth of woody habitat were bulldozed in New South Wales every day in 2024, according to new government data which shows the state has failed to rein in high rates of clearing.
Clearing of vegetation across the state increased by 16% in 2024, reaching 81,293 hectares (200,879 acres) in total – an area more than 275 times the size of the Sydney CBD. The increase was due to a sharp jump in clearing of non-woody vegetation, up 70% on the previous year.
Environment groups said the numbers, published in the annual Statewide Landcover and Tree Study (Slats) report on Tuesday, showed the Minns government had failed to deliver its promise to stem the state’s high rates of clearing.
“Given there’s been no policy change since the government were elected in 2023 it’s no surprise to see that land clearing hasn’t been fixed,” said Jacqui Mumford, chief executive of the Nature Conservation Council of NSW.
“It’s incredibly disappointing when they had a commitment to rein in land clearing that we’re still seeing such high rates.”
Land-clearing has been tracked in NSW for the past 20 years.
The data is categorised into woody – meaning trees and shrubs – and non-woody vegetation, which includes ground cover plants, herbs and grasses.
In 2024, 24,103 hectares of woody vegetation was cleared, a decline on the previous year – when clearing skyrocketed to 32,837 hectares – and 19% below the 2018-2024 average of 29,800 hectares.
But WWF-Australia said the rate of woody habitat clearing was still too high and was the equivalent of clearing about 88 rugby league fields every day for a year.
“Every hectare of trees bulldozed means fewer homes for wildlife and more carbon pollution in the atmosphere,” said Dr Stuart Blanch, WWF-Australia’s forest policy manager.
Blanch said the report was the first that documented a period of time entirely under the Minns government’s watch and “the results are alarming”.
The data reveals a 16% increase in overall clearing due to a sharp jump in clearing of non-woody vegetation.
In 2024, the amount of non-woody vegetation cleared reached at least 57,190 hectares, compared with at least 33,651 hectares the previous year. That figure was also 13% above the 2018-2024 average of 50,700 hectares.
Most of the clearing – 60% – was classified as “unallocated” meaning it did not have a permit, either because it did not require one or the clearing was unlawful.
More than 80% of the clearing was for agriculture, while the remainder was for infrastructure and native forestry.
“The NSW premier, Chris Minns, promised to rein in land-clearing but he has failed to prioritise it and the result is a predictable one,” said the Australian Conservation Foundation’s Nathaniel Pelle.
“All of that vegetation was habitat for native animals and was sequestering carbon so those numbers tell a story of massive damage to nature and the climate in NSW.”
Mumford called on the government to fix the state’s vegetation rules, which were relaxed under the previous Coalition government in 2016.
She also called for the government to scrap a specific clearing designation known as “invasive native species”. This classification allows landholders to clear native vegetation that has regrown in ways that are different to its original state.
It accounted for 61% authorised clearing – meaning clearing that had a permit – on rural regulated land in 2024, according to the data.
Mumford said the invasive native species classification was not a scientific classification and “allows landholders to clear native vegetation under the guise of invasive native species”.
“It’s one of the key drivers of land-clearing and habitat loss in NSW and that classification needs to be removed,” she said.
On Tuesday the NSW Greens said they would introduce a private members’ bill to repeal the former Coalition government’s changes to native vegetation laws and address the state’s “runaway” land-clearing when parliament resumes.
 “Half of the current Labor cabinet lined up to slam these laws when they were introduced, so what is stopping them from fixing them?” the Greens environment spokesperson, Sue Higginson, said.

title: Pauline Hanson shares Seven pitch for Spotlight special that says program would highlight ‘uncontrolled immigration’
summary:
One Nation leader posts network’s proposal to travel to UK to explore what Australia faces ‘if we don’t take back control of who comes to our country’

  • Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates

  • Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast

A Seven producer urged Pauline Hanson to travel to Britain to meet Nigel Farage and film a Spotlight special highlighting so-called “uncontrolled immigration”, according to a pitch posted to social media by the One Nation leader.

The pitch also suggested that Seven might cover some of the travel costs for the One Nation leader and her team and that the program wanted the Reform UK leader to “invite Ms Hanson to Britain”.

Continue reading...
full_text:
A Seven producer urged Pauline Hanson to travel to Britain to meet Nigel Farage and film a Spotlight special highlighting so-called “uncontrolled immigration”, according to a pitch posted to social media by the One Nation leader.
The pitch also suggested that Seven might cover some of the travel costs for the One Nation leader and her team and that the program wanted the Reform UK leader to “invite Ms Hanson to Britain”.
The current affairs program strongly endorsed an anti-immigration position, and said they had the facts to prove what was “the backbone of our story”. The email used the phrase “uncontrolled immigration” seven times.
The senior producer Luke Mortimer said the program would “illustrate the strain uncontrolled immigration is placing on our infrastructure” and demonstrate what Australia is allegedly facing “if we don’t take back control of who comes to our country”.
“Voters in Britain are seeing pictures of boatloads of migrants, often young men from the Middle East and Africa, crossing the British Channel, and they’re seeing their seaside towns turned into camps for people who claim refugee status,” Mortimer said, in a pitch Hanson shared on her Facebook page on Monday.
It is the latest flashpoint between Hanson and Spotlight, after the special aired on Sunday, and another instance of One Nation seeking to clarify or explain parts of her recent European trip.
Hanson’s Facebook post came after a Sky News interview on Monday where One Nation MP Barnaby Joyce alleged Seven had pushed for Hanson to appear on Tommy Robinson’s podcast, repeating a claim made by Hanson’s chief of staff James Ashby last week. “I get the inference that it was a suggestion by Spotlight more than a suggestion by Pauline,” Joyce claimed.
A spokesperson for Seven told Guardian Australia last week that it had been granted rare access to Hanson abroad, and had paid for some production costs, but did not confirm the organisation of the meeting.
Despite the sympathetic approach of the producer, Hanson was grilled by reporter Liam Bartlett about why she met Robinson, a man who has violent criminal convictions and is considered too extreme for Nigel Farage’s rightwing Reform UK party.
In the post, Hanson asks her followers “if last night’s show reflects their pitch?”
Bartlett told viewers Hanson was supposed to meet Farage but the meeting was overtaken by events when he resigned from the UK parliament and called a byelection in the face of financial scrutiny.
Seven has confirmed it was a Spotlight pitch but distanced itself from the leaked email by saying it was one of hundreds of communications between Seven and Hanson’s team in the run-up to the show.
In the email, Mortimer appears to imply the program would fund Hanson’s travel to the UK. “We can discuss travel arrangements,” Mortimer said.
Seven has denied paying for Hanson’s travel.
“There have been extensive, if not hundreds of emails, phone calls and messages over more than six months to organise this Spotlight special, with many developments in the news cycle leading to what was broadcast last night,” a spokesperson for Seven said on Monday.
“Spotlight is proud to have produced a balanced piece of journalism which fairly quizzed Senator Hanson but also allowed her views to be explored and heard in a high-rating special and we thank Senator Hanson for her candid access.”
The email from Mortimer repeats the talking points of One Nation and anti-immigration activists and claims many Australians are unhappy with the levels of immigration.
“Many Australians would be shocked to know our figures are already further down the line – 38.1% of Greater Sydney was born overseas,” he said. “Council areas such as Strathfield have a population of almost 60% that was born overseas.”
The program proposed taking Farage and Hanson to the UK seaside town of Bournemouth, which it claimed “has seen a surge of more than 50% of foreign-born residents, thousands of which are being housed in hotels at the taxpayers expense”.
Instead, the program filmed Hanson and Robinson walking through Luton, 50km north of London, which has a significant Muslim population.
“I hate seeing the burqa,” Hanson said on camera.
“These women covered up, I can’t stand it … I don’t want this happening in Australia.”
Bartlett also asked Hanson about her view on the “concept of mass deportation”.
“Oh, I love it,” she said, but clarified she was targeting “the ones who are here illegally in the country”.
Asked for his position on Hanson’s comments about Muslims on Monday night, Joyce first acknowledged Robinson had done “some things” that were “basically against the law” but said Hanson was not “condoning of every action of Tommy Robinson. I don’t think that was ever said.”
Hanson and her colleagues have spent days explaining or walking back headline-grabbing parts of her trip to Europe, including the Robinson interview, her comments about the White Australia policy, her attendance at a Dolce & Gabbana fashion show and downtime by a hotel pool in Italy with the mining billionaire Gina Rinehart.

title: Almost 100 troops injured in recent weeks, Pentagon admits, as Iran launches reprisals on US allies
summary:
Iran has attacked a tanker in the strait of Hormuz, forcing its crew to abandon the ship, after the US launched a tenth consecutive night of strikes

  • Middle East crisis live: follow latest updates

Nearly 100 US service members have been injured over the last two weeks of escalating strikes on Iran, the Pentagon has said, as Tehran launched a wave of reprisals to the tenth consecutive night of attacks.

Iran’s Revolutionary Guards said on Tuesday they had targeted US military sites including air defence systems and a radar installation in Bahrain and Kuwait, while a tanker in the strait of Hormuz reported being ⁠struck by an unknown projectile, forcing its crew to abandon the vessel and board a lifeboat.

Continue reading...
full_text:
Nearly 100 US service members have been injured over the last two weeks of escalating strikes on Iran, the Pentagon has said, as Tehran launched a wave of reprisals to the tenth consecutive night of attacks.
Iran’s Revolutionary Guards said on Tuesday they had targeted US military sites including air defence systems and a radar installation in Bahrain and Kuwait, while a tanker in the strait of Hormuz reported being struck by an unknown projectile, forcing its crew to abandon the vessel and board a lifeboat.
Kuwait, Bahrain and Jordan all said they had activated defences to repel the attacks, but the scale of US injuries at facilities across the region over recent week is likely to bring greater scrutiny to Iran’s reprisal attacks.
Pentagon spokesperson Sean Parnell said the vast majority of those injured only experienced “minor concussions” and 96% had since returned to work. Parnell was responding to a New York Times report that the Pentagon has withheld information about troop injuries from Iranian strikes. He denied that the Pentagon was hiding data about injuries.
In the last week three US soldiers have been killed in action in Jordan and Iraq.
The 10 consecutive nights of US airstrikes haven’t compelled Tehran to loosen its grip on the strait of Hormuz, through which about a fifth of all crude oil and natural gas traded once passed in peacetime. Efforts to rein in the costs that the disruption is having on global trade and oil prices were complicated further on Monday, after Yemen’s Iranian-backed Houthis announced they were imposing a maritime embargo against Saudi Arabia.
There were few details on how the embargo might work, but a Houthi official said that the Bab al-Mandeb strait – at the southern end of the Red Sea through which about 12% of the world’s trade usually passes – would be closed to the Saudis in response to the kingdom’s “unjust blockade on Yemenis for over 10 years”.
The Houthis have demonstrated their ability to disrupt shipping in the past by targeting vessels over the Israel-Hamas war in Gaza.
Saudi Arabia’s military said it would keep the waterway open, but the threat will put further pressure on the country’s oil exports, as it has increased shipping from Red Sea ports sue to the closure of the strait of Hormuz.
Even as the US and Iran inch closer to all-out war again, Iran’s interior minister travelled to Pakistan, a key mediator in the conflict, for talks. However, it remains unclear just what new deal could be reached, after the interim deal signed last month that was meant to end the fighting crumbled.
Shipping through the strait of Hormuz has largely stalled. And as fighting intensifies, both sides have targeted civilian infrastructure relied on by millions of people.
The escalation has pushed oil prices higher in recent weeks. Benchmark Brent crude traded on Tuesday above $88 a barrel and regular petrol in the US climbed to an average of $4 a gallon, keeping pressure on Americans’ wallets ahead of midterm elections this November.
The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations agency (UKMTO) said it had received multiple reports on Tuesday that a tanker had been hit by an unknown projectile. The incident was reported eight nautical miles east of Oman’s Limah. Iran’s Revolutionary Guards later claimed the attack, as well as two other attacks on ships Monday in the waterway.
UKMTO said the tanker’s company security officer had reported that the crew had abandoned the vessel and were aboard a lifeboat and no environmental impact had been reported.
The route around Oman has been the one the US military has encouraged ships to travel to avoid Iran’s control.
With Reuters and the Associated Press

title: XRP jumps 4% as traders watch 'triangle breakout' toward $1.35
full_text:
XRP jumps 4% as traders watch 'triangle breakout' toward $1.35
XRP pushed higher over 24 hours and tested short-term resistance, but the larger chart still needs a clean break above the $1.24-$1.28 supply zone to confirm a stronger reversal.
- XRP climbed about 4.6% to trade near $1.13, a key short-term level that traders say could trigger a breakout toward $1.35 if it holds.
- While the hourly chart shows XRP compressing in a symmetrical triangle and attempting a breakout, the token remains stuck in a larger descending channel on the daily chart.
- Analysts are watching resistance at $1.24 to $1.28 and support at $1.02 to $1.06, with a loss of that support zone potentially exposing the $0.88 to $0.92 area.
XRP is trying to turn a support defense into a breakout. The token rose more than 4% over 24 hours and pushed toward $1.13, the level traders are watching after price compressed inside a short-term symmetrical triangle.
A move through that area could open the path toward $1.35, but the bigger daily chart still shows XRP trading inside a descending channel that has capped rallies for months.
News Background
• XRP traded near $1.13 on Monday, up about 4.6% over 24 hours, according to CoinGecko data.
• The token’s 24-hour range stretched from $1.08 to $1.14, with market capitalization near $70.85 billion and 24-hour trading volume around $1.27 billion.
• Analyst Ali Martinez said on X that XRP’s monthly chart is showing a TD Sequential buy signal, while the hourly chart shows price consolidating inside a symmetrical triangle.
• Martinez said a breakout above $1.13 could open the door to a roughly 20% rally toward $1.35.
Price Action Summary
• XRP opened near $1.0925 and climbed as high as $1.1067 on CoinDesk Data’s 24-hour chart before extending toward $1.13 on CoinGecko.
• The move followed several hours of sideways trading between roughly $1.09 and $1.11 before buyers pushed price higher in the morning session.
• Volume increased during the breakout attempt, with CoinGecko showing 24-hour trading volume of about $1.27 billion.
• XRP held above the $1.08-$1.10 area through the session, keeping the short-term recovery structure intact.
Technical Analysis
• The key short-term level is $1.13. A sustained break above it would confirm the triangle breakout watched by traders and bring $1.35 into focus.
• The hourly structure has tightened into a symmetrical triangle, with price compressing between lower highs and higher lows before the latest push higher.
• The daily chart remains more cautious. XRP is still trading inside a descending channel, with the 100-day and 200-day moving averages above price and sloping lower.
• The $1.24-$1.28 area remains the bigger resistance zone because it lines up with the channel’s upper boundary and major moving averages.
• Support remains strongest around $1.02-$1.06, where buyers have repeatedly stepped in over recent weeks.
What traders should watch
• $1.13 is the immediate breakout level. Holding above it would strengthen the short-term bullish setup.
• $1.14 is the next nearby level after marking the top of the latest 24-hour range.
• $1.24-$1.28 is the major resistance zone that XRP needs to clear before the daily chart turns meaningfully stronger.
• $1.02-$1.06 remains the key demand zone. Losing it would expose $0.88-$0.92.
• Until XRP clears $1.24-$1.28, the market remains a short-term breakout attempt inside a larger descending channel.

full_text:
Hedge funds are dumping tech stocks at the fastest pace in a decade
Hedge funds have sold U.S. information technology stocks in six of the last eight weeks, making the eight-week total the largest in at least 10 years, according to The Kobeissi Letter, citing prime brokerage data.
Technology was the single most-sold U.S. sector last week.
That has cut tech's share of hedge fund market exposure to its lowest since February, and at the current pace it could fall to a five-year low as early as next week.
The takeaway is that funds are moving to the sidelines, not rotating from one trade into another.
For bitcoin, broad de-risking is not the same as the AI trade simply moving elsewhere. It leaves crypto without the risk-on backdrop that a straightforward tech-to-chips rotation still provided.

title: UK Parliament begins inquiry into banking chokepoint for crypto businesses
full_text:
UK Parliament begins inquiry into banking chokepoint for crypto businesses
The UK’s Crypto and Digital Assets All-Party Parliamentary Group (APPG) is focused on banks that refused crypto firms accounts or introduced restrictions on crypto transactions.
- The APPG is inviting written evidence from across the banking, payments, fintech and crypto sectors over a six-week call for evidence.
- The inquiry will then publish a report setting out its findings and recommendations to the UK Government.
UK politicians want to know the extent to which the country’s banks have choked-off cryptocurrency firms by refusing them bank accounts and introducing restrictions on crypto-related payments, in a cross-party inquiry kicked off on Tuesday.
The UK’s Crypto and Digital Assets All-Party Parliamentary Group (APPG) is chaired by Lord Vaizey of Didcot, the former UK Government Minister for the Digital Economy, and Labour MP Gurinder Singh Josan CBE, according to a press release.
Ever since crypto came into being, difficulties around attaining banking relationships have made life hard for players in the space, with a systematic debanking of firms and individuals, particularly in the U.S. being referred to as “Operation Chokepoint 2.0.”
Several major UK banks have also introduced restrictions on crypto-related payments, the APPG said in a statement. As such the inquiry will focus on a dearth of bank accounts for crypto businesses, including associated professional services such as insurance.
The APPG will also look at restrictions placed by banks on crypto-related transactions, amid concerns that some UK banks have introduced measures such as blocking payments to certain crypto firms, or imposing transfer limits. The inquiry wants to understand how these restrictions are being applied, whether they are proportionate and what impact they have on consumers, businesses, innovation and competition, APPG said.
"Over a number of years, the APPG has heard consistent reports from crypto and digital asset businesses that they face difficulties accessing bank accounts and banking services, alongside concerns about restrictions on crypto-related transactions by banks,” APPG co-chair Lord Vaizey of Didcot said.
The APPG is inviting written evidence from across the banking, payments, fintech and crypto sectors over a six-week call for evidence before publishing a report setting out its findings and recommendations to the Government.

title: Bitcoin hits a two-week high near $65,500 as the chip trade turns back into a tailwind
full_text:
Bitcoin hits a two-week high near $65,500 as the chip trade turns back into a tailwind
Asian semiconductor shares rebounded hard, a five-day ETF inflow streak passed $600 million, and oil pulled back on Middle East diplomacy.
- Bitcoin climbed to a two-week high around $65,500 as a rebound in Asian semiconductor stocks fueled a broader risk rally, with ether and several major tokens also advancing.
- The move has been supported by five straight days of inflows into U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs totaling more than $600 million, marking the strongest stretch of institutional buying since mid-July.
- Traders see the Federal Reserve’s late-July meeting as the key test for the rally, with low but fair crypto prices, subdued spot volumes and the prospect of further rate hikes all limiting conviction.
Bitcoin climbed to about $65,500 on Tuesday, a two-week high, as the semiconductor selloff that dragged crypto lower last week reversed and Asian chip stocks led a broad risk rally.
The largest cryptocurrency rose 1% on the day and 5% on the week, with roughly $33 billion changing hands. Ether was the stronger of the two majors again at $1,922, up 3% on the day and 8% over seven sessions. XRP added 3% to $1.13 and is up 6% on the week, Solana rose 2% to $78, BNB held at $574 and dogecoin was flat. Hyperliquid's HYPE gained 4% to $63 but remains the only major underwater over the week.
The rebound started where last week's damage did. MSCI's Asia Pacific equities gauge climbed 2%, its first gain in four sessions, with Samsung and Taiwan Semiconductor the biggest contributors.
South Korea and Taiwan benchmarks each rose about 4%, and a tech-heavy mainland China gauge jumped almost 7% as state-linked institutions stepped in. Japan's Nikkei rose 3% after slipping into correction on Friday. The Chinese AI shock that hit chip stocks last week has, for now, given way to buyers returning to the same names.
Two other supports lined up behind the move. U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs have now drawn inflows for five straight sessions totaling more than $600 million, the most sustained institutional buying since mid-July and a reversal of the eight-week outflow run that ran through late June.
And oil, which had climbed for two days on the war, pulled back, with Brent falling 1% to about $88.58 as Iran said mediators were circulating proposals to ease hostilities, including a reported suggestion for a 10-day halt in strikes.
"Current bitcoin and ether prices are low but fair, given the macro uncertainties pervading markets," said Jeff Mei, chief operating officer at BTSE, who pointed to the Fed meeting as the event traders are positioned around.
"Traders expect rates to hold steady but are looking for more signals as to what's to come later in the year,” Mei added.
The read on that meeting is where the rally meets its limit. The Federal Reserve gathers July 28 and 29, and markets put the odds of a July rate increase at about 15%, though a September move is still live.
Spot-market volume across crypto stayed subdued even as prices rose, the sign of a tape lifted by returning risk appetite rather than fresh conviction, and higher oil and Treasury yields remain the levers that could keep the Fed hawkish and cap risk assets.
The same force that set the direction all month is simply pointing the other way now. Bitcoin fell last week because Asian chip stocks did, and it is at a two-week high this week because they bounced.

title: Bitcoin ETFs post five-day inflow streak, longest since May
summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $227 million in inflows as BTC climbed above $65,000, extending their longest winning streak since early May.
full_text:
Bitcoin ETFs post five-day inflow streak, longest since May
US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $227 million in inflows as BTC climbed above $65,000, extending their longest winning streak since early May.
US-listed spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) posted their fifth consecutive day of net inflows, marking their longest winning streak in nearly three months.
Bitcoin ETFs attracted $226.9 million in net inflows on Monday, the strongest daily inflows since July 6, bringing total net inflows over the five-day streak to about $727.3 million, according to data provider SoSoValue.
The five-session streak is the longest run of consecutive inflows since a six-session stretch from April 30 through May 5. Monday’s inflows reduced year-to-date net outflows for US spot Bitcoin ETFs to below $5 billion.
Simon-Peter Massabni, head of business development at XS.com, said the recent inflows suggest selling pressure may be easing rather than signaling a broad return of institutional demand. He added that Bitcoin would need to break and hold above the $65,000–$65,500 range to strengthen the case for a sustained uptrend.
At the time of publication, BTC traded at $65,879, up 3.3% over the past 24 hours, according to CoinGecko.

summary: The Coinbase-backed Ethereum layer-2 is preparing to expand its financial offerings as it pivots away from its earlier social-first strategy.
full_text:
Base’s 1:1-backed tokenized equities launch ‘imminent,’ Pollak says
The Coinbase-backed Ethereum layer-2 is preparing to expand its financial offerings as it pivots away from its earlier social-first strategy.
Base is close to launching 1:1-backed tokenized equities, according to Jesse Pollak, creator of Coinbase’s Ethereum layer-2 network.
Pollak said in a Tuesday X post that Robinhood Chain, the recently launched Ethereum layer 2, had gotten tokenized equities in an EVM environment right, adding that Base was behind on that front.
Lazer Technologies head of fintech Garrett Skrovina asked about the timeline for launching 1:1-backed equities on Base, to which Pollak replied: “Imminent — dotting i’s and crossing t’s, but should be very soon.”
The launch comes as Base accelerates its pivot toward financial applications from its earlier focus on social products.
Pollak recently said Base made a “wrong bet” by prioritizing creator, content and messaging apps. The network is now focused on trading, payments, AI agents and tokenized assets.

title: UK parliamentary group launches probe into crypto sector’s banking challenges
summary: This comes weeks after the publication of the UK’s new crypto regulatory framework, set to take effect in October 2027.
full_text:
UK parliamentary group launches probe into crypto sector's banking challenges
Quick Take
- The Crypto and Digital Assets All-Party Parliamentary Group announced Tuesday that it will examine the challenges the crypto sector faces in accessing banking services.
- This comes weeks after the publication of the UK’s new crypto regulatory framework, set to take effect in October 2027.
- The inquiry also coincides with a major political shift in the UK on Monday, as Labour Party’s Andy Burnham takes office as Prime Minister.
We'd love your feedback.
The UK Parliament's cross-party group for digital assets has launched an inquiry into banking access for the country's crypto sector.
The Crypto and Digital Assets All-Party Parliamentary Group (APPG) — chaired by Lord Vaizey of Didcot and Labour MP Gurinder Singh Josan CBE — announced the probe on Tuesday.
The group aims to examine difficulties crypto businesses face in opening and maintaining bank accounts in the UK, as well as restrictions some UK banks have placed on crypto-related transactions.
"The APPG has heard consistent reports from crypto and digital asset businesses that they face difficulties accessing bank accounts and banking services," the group said in the statement. "Access to banking services is fundamental for any legitimate business, and where unnecessary barriers exist they have the potential to hinder growth, investment and innovation.”
Ongoing crypto reform
The inquiry will also examine international approaches adopted in jurisdictions including the U.S., Hong Kong, Australia, and the EU.
The APPG is inviting written evidence from the banking, payments, fintech and crypto sectors for six weeks — from July 21 to Aug. 31. The group plans to publish a report on findings and recommendations to the government thereafter.
This comes weeks after the publication of the UK's new crypto regulatory framework and aims to assess whether these barriers risk undermining the government's ambition for the UK to become a global leader in digital assets.
"With the publication of the UK's new crypto regulatory framework, now is the right time to examine whether any remaining barriers could undermine that ambition as the regime comes into force next year," the group said. The framework is scheduled to take effect on Oct. 25, 2027.
New Prime Minister
The inquiry coincides with a major political shift in the UK on Monday, as Labour Party's Andy Burnham takes office as prime minister.
Burnham announced his intention to scrap the previous government's digital ID scheme, redirecting resources toward cost-of-living measures. Local experts said abandoning digital IDs will leave the UK lagging globally.
Stefan Deiss, co-founder and CEO of The Hashgraph Group, said in a statement that stepping back from the idea of a single, centralized government managing every citizen's digital ID was the right decision, but the country should not discard the idea entirely.
"The technology has moved on, and there's now a better way: credentials held in a secure wallet on the citizen's own phone, not on a state server," Deiss said. "Burnham has promised a government that works for ordinary people. Identity that citizens genuinely own is precisely that. Pause the old model, but don't lose the ambition."
Burnham also named John Healey as chancellor of the Exchequer — the top finance official of the country.
Jonathan Herbst, Global Head of Financial Services at law firm Norton Rose Fulbright, said that the new chancellor will likely ensure that ongoing financial reforms are delivered in a predictable and coordinated manner.
"For internationally active firms, the UK's attractiveness depends not just on the substance of the rules but on the stability of the regulatory environment," Herbst said. "Areas such as capital markets, fintech, digital assets and sustainable finance will continue to be important tests of that commitment."

title: Washington judge blocks Kalshi’s sports prediction markets over state gambling laws
summary: A Washington state court granted the state's motion for a preliminary injunction, saying Kalshi operates illegal gambling activities.
full_text:
Washington judge blocks Kalshi's sports prediction markets over state gambling laws
Quick Take
- A Washington court has granted the request to temporarily block Kalshi from offering sports-related event contracts in the state.
- The judge said Kalshi operates illegal gambling activities under the state’s law.
We'd love your feedback.
A Washington court has granted a request to temporarily block Kalshi from offering sports-related event contracts in the state, saying it operates illegal gambling activities under state law.
According to the court document filed Monday, Judge John McHale of King County Superior Court in Washington granted the state's motion for a preliminary injunction against Kalshi.
"[It] offers illegal gambling activities to Washington consumers and solicits bets from Washington consumers on its platform," the judge wrote.
"The public interests at stake and potential harm to consumers in the continued operation of Kalshi's online gambling activities in the State of Washington outweigh harm to Kalshi," the judge added.
The court said it will review additional materials from Kalshi and the state by Aug. 3 and that the preliminary injunction will not take effect until at least Aug. 5.
"The Court will allow the parties to confer with the hope that Kalshi, through experience with other States, may provide insight into effective ways to protect Washingtonians as the State seeks to do," the judge said.
The dispute centers on whether Kalshi's sports event contracts fall under federal regulation or state gambling laws. The state argues that the contracts violate state gambling laws, while Kalshi contends that the federal Commodity Exchange Act (CEA) preempts those laws.
In the Monday filing, the judge explicitly wrote that the CEA does not preempt Washington state.
"States don't have jurisdiction to regulate prediction markets," a Kalshi spokesperson told The Block in response to Monday's ruling. "Many courts — including the Third Circuit — have made this clear. We're disappointed to see Washington state continue wasting taxpayer dollars."
Nationwide legal battle
The Washington ruling marks the latest setback for Kalshi, federally regulated by the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC). The prediction markets platform has been battling state regulators over its sports-event contracts.
Last month, a Michigan judge issued a temporary restraining order against Kalshi, blocking the platform from offering sports-related event contracts in the state. Earlier this month, a judge in New York denied Kalshi's request to block the state from enforcing its gambling laws against the prediction market platform.
Sports and gaming attorney Daniel Wallach told The Block that Judge McHale's Monday ruling aligns with the approach taken by most courts that have considered similar cases.
"To date, there have been 23 judicial decisions on whether a preliminary injunction or temporary restraining order should be issued in connection with prediction-market cases. The states have won 19 out of 23," said Wallach. "The tide is turning sharply in the states' favor."
Wallach pointed out that Kalshi is already barred from offering sports-event contracts in Nevada and Michigan, with Washington poised to become another state on the list.
"While this question ultimately will be decided by the Supreme Court within a few years, Kalshi's map for sports-related contracts could look markedly different in six months than it did earlier this year when it was not the subject of any injunctions barring it from offering sports contracts," Wallach added.
Meanwhile, the CFTC sued New York in April to block state enforcement against CFTC-registered exchanges. The agency is seeking a declaratory judgment that federal law grants it exclusive authority over event contracts, according to its statement.
Kalshi remains the largest prediction market platform in the world in trading volume, ahead of rival Polymarket. Kalshi's monthly volume reached $33 billion in June, while Polymarket and its U.S. platform saw a combined $13.95 billion, according to The Block's data dashboard.

title: CZ 自傳《幣安人生》繁體中文版上架，博客來、誠品都有賣
summary:
幣安創辦人趙長鵬（CZ）的首部回憶錄《Freedom of Money》繁體中文版《幣安人生：幸運、韌性與保護 […]

〈CZ 自傳《幣安人生》繁體中文版上架，博客來、誠品都有賣〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
幣安創辦人趙長鵬（CZ）的首部回憶錄《Freedom of Money》繁體中文版《幣安人生：幸運、韌性與保護用戶的回憶錄》已正式在台發行，不僅在博客來上架、誠品也有相關頁面，Amazon 亦同步販售。本書由 Ray Dalio、Larry Fink、不丹國王、海底撈張勇等重量級人物親自撰寫推薦語，是 2026 年加密貨幣圈最受矚目的出版作品之一。
（前情提要：幣安創辦人趙長鵬 CZ 的回憶錄《Freedom of Money》：從炸薯條少年到加密貨幣帝國，獄中寫下的 72 則人生守則）
（背景補充：CZ《Freedom of Money》自傳收益 100% 捐慈善，書中首次公開入獄 4 個月心路歷程）
趙長鵬（Changpeng Zhao，暱稱 CZ）作為全球最大加密貨幣交易所幣安的創辦人，其個人傳奇經歷一直是幣圈焦點。他的首部回憶錄《Freedom of Money》於 4 月 8 日出版，繁體中文版《幣安人生》同步在台發行。本書被定義為「一半回憶錄，一半宣言」，多數內容完成於 CZ 服刑期間，圍繞「幸運、韌性、保護用戶」三大主線，回顧其從草根崛起、建立全球最大加密貨幣交易所到認罪入獄的完整歷程。
推薦陣容：從不丹國王到海底撈創始人
本書的推薦語陣容堪稱豪華，涵蓋金融、商業與政治領域的重量級人物：
- Ray Dalio（橋水基金創辦人）：「我一直很欣賞 CZ，他敢想敢做，大膽推動加密貨幣走向全球大眾。不管你是想從平凡起點闖出一片天，還是單純好奇 CZ 怎麼把 Binance 做成新貨幣秩序的支柱，這本書都值得一讀。」
- Larry Fink（貝萊德聯合創辦人、董事長兼執行長）：「這本書以第一人稱視角，講述了 CZ 在加密貨幣與數字資產萌芽階段創業與領導歷程的真實經歷。」
- 不丹國王吉格梅·凱薩爾·納姆耶爾·旺楚克陛下：「CZ 很早就看見了許多人直到今天才開始理解的事：數字資產與區塊鏈技術，能為願意擁抱未來的國家釋放真正的機會。」
- 張勇（海底撈創始人）：「每個時代都需要敢於突破邊界的人。CZ 跌宕起伏的經歷證明，勇氣與堅持可以創造新的可能，哪怕是孤勇前行。」
72 條人生原則首次公開
書中最特別的部分，是 CZ 在附錄中親手寫下 72 條人生原則，涵蓋創業、管理與人生感悟。書中詳細描述了從中國農村童年、移民加拿大、在彭博社工作，再到幣安快速崛起的故事，並首次揭露幣安高速成長背後的代價、合規化過程中的挑戰，以及在危機中保護用戶的決策心境。
認罪入獄與獄中寫作
2023 年，美國司法部指控幣安違反《銀行保密法》，認為平台早期未完善文書程序，讓美國用戶也能使用服務。CZ 選擇自願自首認罪，幣安支付 43 億美元罰款，他本人則被判處 4 個月有期徒刑。
CZ 透露，本書大部分內容正是在監獄內用一台功能受限的筆電完成的。而最令人意外的轉折是，出獄後他竟因「簽證逾期」遭國土安全部拘留，原因在於法院命令他不得離開美國，這反而讓他陷入逾期停留的違規狀態。這段經歷被他形容為「既令人氣憤，又引人入勝」。
台灣通路資訊
《幣安人生》繁體中文版目前在台灣主要通路均有銷售：
書籍資訊：
- 書名：《幣安人生：幸運、韌性與保護用戶的回憶錄》（Freedom of Money）
- 作者：趙長鵬（CZ）
- 出版日期：2026 年 7 月 21 日
- 語言：繁體中文
對於想了解 CZ 內心世界、加密貨幣產業發展史，或純粹對這位「加密貨幣教父」的第一手敘述感興趣的讀者，這是一本不容錯過的作品。CZ 此前宣布將書籍全部收益 100% 捐贈給教育類慈善機構，讓這本回憶錄的意義超越了商業出版。

title: 數學 ≠ 考試，真正的數學是一種超能力
summary:
真正的數學，是人類最深的一套工具，用來看清現實真正的樣子，它是現實運行的語言、能在雜訊中找出規律、給出唯一真正 […]

〈數學 ≠ 考試，真正的數學是一種超能力〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
真正的數學，是人類最深的一套工具，用來看清現實真正的樣子，它是現實運行的語言、能在雜訊中找出規律、給出唯一真正的確定性、馴服無窮、把不確定性化為可計算的量。本文整理、翻譯自 @thelichhh 文章。
（前情提要：七巨頭開始跑輸大盤！報告：AI 資本支出正吃掉 Mag 7 的現金流）
（背景補充：觀點：半導體接棒「美股七巨頭」領漲，標普 500 準備衝破 8000 點）
數學不是計算。它是人類擁有的、用來看清「真正存在著什麼」的最深一套工具 — 而學校幾乎沒有把它交到你手上。
大多數人都帶著一道來自數學課堂的小小傷口。一次考試、一位老師、一個某扇門關上的瞬間，而那訊息紮紮實實地落下：這東西不適合你。那道傷口來自一場偷天換日。學校交到你手上的，是算術與程序。算這個。背那個。把符號移到等號另一邊。真正的數學，幾乎與這種苦差事相反。它是我們所擁有、最接近「描述現實如何被建構」的一種語言，而一旦你看見了它哪怕一點點，世界就不再看起來像雜訊，而開始看起來像結構。
這無關乎通過一場考試。它關乎數學究竟是什麼，以及當沒有人在給你打分數時，它會如何改變你觀看世界的方式。以下就是這門真正的學問，分成六個部分。
一、數學是現實看起來被書寫於其中的語言
位於一切核心的那個奇異事實是這樣的：由人發明、依規則在紙上被推來推去的抽象符號，竟持續以荒謬的準確度預測著物理世界。
有人推導出一條心中並無任何應用的方程式。數十年後，它竟被發現能描述行星如何運行、電流如何流動，或族群如何增長。這種事發生得如此頻繁，以至於物理學家給了它一個名字：數學那不合理的有效性。
沒有人完全知道它為何管用。但這意味著，數學並不是我們拴在現實之上、用來描述它的一種記號。現實，似乎就運行在數學所運行的同一套邏輯之上。學會這門語言，你就不是在背誦一門科目。你是在閱讀「萬物如何行為」的原始碼。
這重新框定了整件事。數學不再是眾多科目中的一門。它成了物理、生物、金融、音樂，以及每一台如今會思考的機器底下的那一層。
二、它在看似純粹的雜訊之中找出秩序
你被教過的那些乾淨的形狀 — 圓、三角形與平滑的曲線 — 幾乎描述不了任何你真正能觸摸的東西。海岸線不是線。雲不是球。山不是圓錐。真實的世界是粗糙、破碎且不規則的。
數學的力量在於：那份粗糙並不是混沌。它有規則。一條鋸齒狀的海岸線，會在每一個尺度上重複它自己的樣式 — 從衛星視角一路縮小到一塊石頭 — 而一條短短的公式，就能捕捉那份重複。同樣的想法 — 結構藏在看似的一團亂之中 — 貫穿了整個領域。
質數看起來隨機，卻藏著深刻的規律。一群人、一個市場、一股湍流，全都看似無序，卻遵循著你能寫下來的定律。這正是數學思維的核心動作：別再看見雜訊，開始找出雜訊所服從的那條規則。一旦你掌握了它，你就能在「單憑肉眼觀看什麼也得不到」的地方做出預測。
三、它是人類唯一能取得真正確定性的地方
其他每一個領域，處理的都是「明天可能就被推翻」的證據。一項科學結果，只是我們最好的猜測，直到一個更好的實驗到來。一份數學證明，則在種類上就不同。
當某件事被證明時，它就永遠被定案了。兩千多年前，希臘人證明了質數有無窮多個，而自那以後的任何發現，都不曾、也永遠不會撼動它分毫。那份恆久，在所有人類知識之中是獨一無二的。一份證明，是一條緊到「只要你接受起始的規則，你就被迫接受結論、沒有任何扭動空間」的步驟鏈。學會用證明來思考，就是學會「感覺為真」與「就是為真」之間的差別。
它建立起一種你會帶進其他一切事物的心智衛生：那種不問「我相不相信這個」、而問「這個到底成不成立」的習慣。
在一個被自信滿滿的主張所淹沒的世界裡，能夠分辨一個真正的論證與一個只是有說服力的論證，已經接近一項生存技能。
四、它馴服無窮，而不是在它面前退縮
無窮會擊碎尋常的直覺。數學是唯一一個能不慌不亂地處理它的工具，而其結果是真真切切地怪異。
無窮不只有一種大小。計數用的數字綿延不絕，0 與 1 之間的小數也綿延不絕，然而第二種無窮，可被證明比第一種更大。這聽起來不可能，直到你跟上那段論證，然後它就滴水不漏。這不是一個派對上的把戲。
同一套「處理無窮大與無窮小」的機制，正是微積分建立於其上的基礎，而微積分，正是我們用來描述任何會變動之物的方式：運動、增長、熱、金錢，以及一個墜落物體的曲線。數學直直地看向那個人類心智拒絕承載的東西 — 那無盡的 — 並為了與它一同工作，打造出精確的工具。那是這門學問最無所畏懼的樣子。
五、它把不確定性變成你能計算的東西
生活中的大多數事情並不確定，而數學也不假裝並非如此。它最深的實用力量，是在你不知道會發生什麼時，依然能清晰地推理。
機率為機遇賦予了精確的結構。它告訴你一個罕見事件該如何被權衡、為什麼你對巧合的直覺通常是錯的，以及一項證據到底該把你的信念挪動多少。從同樣的根源，長出了「資訊本身可以被衡量」這個想法。
任何訊息、任何信號、任何一串文字，都能被化約為位元(bit)，而對於「能透過一條有雜訊的通道擠過去多少東西」，存在著一個硬性的數學上限。那單單一個洞見，撐起了每一通電話、每一個檔案，以及每一個生成語言的模型。這一切底下的教訓是：不確定性不是拿來猜測的藉口。它是一個你能為它標上數字、並加以推理的量。
這正是「被隨機性所愚弄的人」與「不被愚弄的人」之間的分野。
六、你實際上會拿回什麼
重新奪回數學，無關乎通過任何東西。它是對你「如何觀看」的一次直接升級。
你會開始在過去只看見一團亂的地方注意到結構：一個趨勢、一個風險、你自己工作中一個重複出現的形狀。你會獲得一種「不被數字愚弄」的防禦力 — 而如今人們被愚弄的方式，大多正是這種。你會嚐到真正確定性的滋味，於是一個嚴密的論證與一個油滑的論證，不再看起來一模一樣。而你會獲得一種語言 — 物理、金融、音樂，以及每一個 AI 系統，全都在悄悄地說著它 — 於是那些看似毫不相關的領域，開始彼此押韻。
這一切都不需要一個罕見的基因。它需要的，是解除一個很早就被植入的錯誤信念：這東西從來就不適合你。
全部合起來
一門學問的六張面孔。數學是現實運行於其上的語言。它找出藏在雜訊裡的規則。它給出人類唯一能取得的確定性。它不退縮地處理無窮。它把「不知道」變成一個數字。而它還你一副新的眼睛。
那，才是你坐在其中的每一堂數學課，實際上端上桌的東西。你被反覆操練的那些計算，幾乎都不是它。計算是鷹架。這，才是那棟建築。
收尾
一塊老舊黑板上的那些方程式，看起來像一道築起來把你擋在外面的牆。那正是那場把戲，而它幾乎在每一個人身上都被玩過一次 — 在一個「一個糟糕的下午，就可能決定你一生如何看待自己」的年紀。
數學從來就不是那道牆。它是任何人曾經寫下的、對這個世界最清晰的描述。那扇門，一直都是開著的。

title: Hugging Face 被 AI agent 打穿！最後鑑識模型靠中國開源 GLM 5.2
summary:
Hugging Face 揭露一起由自主 AI agent 驅動的入侵，攻擊者留下逾 17,000 筆記錄事件 […]

〈Hugging Face 被 AI agent 打穿！最後鑑識模型靠中國開源 GLM 5.2〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
Hugging Face 揭露一起由自主 AI agent 驅動的入侵，攻擊者留下逾 17,000 筆記錄事件，一批內部資料集與數個服務憑證遭波及。更尷尬的是事後鑑識，商用前沿模型因安全護欄拒絕處理真實攻擊指令與 C2 產物，資安團隊只好改用 Z.ai 的開源權重模型 GLM 5.2 在自家機器上完成分析。
（前情提要：假 OpenAI 開源模型登 Hugging Face 冠軍！24 萬次下載暗藏惡意軟體）
（背景補充：Google、Meta 研究員聯手喊話：AI Agent 安全不是模型問題，是系統問題）
重點摘要
- Hugging Face 7 月 16 日揭露入侵事件，攻擊者留下逾 17,000 筆記錄事件
- 入口是惡意資料集，串起遠端程式碼載入器與模板注入兩條執行路徑
- 商用前沿模型護欄擋下鑑識請求，改用 Z.ai 開源權重模型 GLM 5.2 收尾
開源 AI 社群龍頭 Hugging Face 在 7 月 16 日發出資安事件揭露，坦承生產環境的一部分遭到入侵，而這場入侵從頭到尾由一套自主 AI agent 系統驅動。攻擊者在系統內留下超過 17,000 筆記錄事件，波及內部資料集，以及數個內部服務使用的憑證。
Hugging Face 的官方說明指出，這份資料集同時濫用了資料集處理流程中的兩條程式碼執行路徑，一條是遠端程式碼資料集載入器，另一條是資料集設定檔裡的模板注入漏洞。兩條串起來，就足以讓攻擊者在處理節點上跑自己的程式，接著往內部叢集橫向移動，收割雲端與叢集憑證。
官方的描述是「一群跑在短命沙盒裡的自動化小程式」，指令與控制基礎設施還會自己搬家，寄生在公開服務上。這種攻擊方式只有 agent 做得出來。
防守方請不動模型
真正的麻煩出現在事後鑑識。要重建完整的攻擊時間軸，分析人員得把大量真實攻擊指令、exploit payload 與 C2 產物餵進模型，而這些東西正好就是安全護欄設計來擋的內容。Hugging Face 寫得很直白，這些請求「被供應商的安全護欄擋下」。
攻擊者不受任何使用政策約束，我們自己的鑑識工作卻被一開始採用的託管模型護欄擋住。
英文原句是「The attacker was bound by no usage policy, while our own forensic work was blocked by the guardrails of the hosted models we first tried.」Hugging Face 全程沒有點名是哪幾家供應商，只說是「一開始採用的託管模型」，但想也知道是美國的主流模型。
最後是中國開源模型收尾
Hugging Face 改用中國新創 Z.ai 的 GLM 5.2 完成鑑識，這是一款六月中旬才發布的開源權重模型，總參數約 7,530 億。關鍵不在跑分，在於它可以整包架在自家機器上跑。
執行長 Clem Delangue 的說法更白：「當你正處理一起進行中的事故，你不能讓工具拒絕檢視惡意 payload，或是反過來把你的帳號標記起來。」他補了一句，攻擊者早就在用 agent，而他們顯然不遵守任何護欄。
Hugging Face 表示，自己並不知道攻擊者的 agent 背後掛的是哪一個模型，可能是被越獄的託管模型，也可能是完全不受限的開源權重模型。這其實不重要，不管是哪一種，攻擊方都不需要通過任何使用政策的審查，防守方需要。
災情範圍目前看起來有限。Hugging Face 說沒有證據顯示公開的模型、資料集、Spaces 或軟體供應鏈遭到竄改，調查仍在進行，會直接聯繫受影響的對象。零信任資安公司 Zero Networks 的 field CTO Chris Boehm 也點出同一個諷刺，為了防禦而設計的安全工具，反過來拖住了資安事故的應變，當下的窘境。
常見問題
Hugging Face 這次被駭外洩了哪些資料？
遭波及的是一批內部資料集與數個內部服務憑證，攻擊者留下逾 17,000 筆記錄事件。官方表示沒有證據顯示公開模型、資料集、Spaces 或軟體供應鏈遭竄改，調查仍在進行。
為什麼商用 AI 模型會拒絕協助資安鑑識？
鑑識得把大量真實攻擊指令、exploit payload 與 C2 產物送進模型，而這些正是安全護欄設計來攔截的內容。護欄讀內容不讀意圖，分不出提問者是攻擊者還是防守方，因此觸發拒答。

Vercel 遭駭、加密開發者急換 API Key：AI 工具 Context.ai 成破口，Web3 前端供應鏈拉警報

title: 歐盟 8 月開鍘：AI 沒「自報身分」最高罰 3% 全球營收，台灣也在範圍內
summary:
歐盟《AI 法案》第 50 條透明度義務將於 2026 年 8 月 2 日在 27 個成員國正式生效，聊天機器 […]

〈歐盟 8 月開鍘：AI 沒「自報身分」最高罰 3% 全球營收，台灣也在範圍內〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
歐盟《AI 法案》第 50 條透明度義務將於 2026 年 8 月 2 日在 27 個成員國正式生效，聊天機器人與 AI 代理必須在第一次互動就告知使用者正在跟機器說話，AI 生成的圖片、音訊與文字則要嵌入機器可讀標記。違規最高罰 1500 萬歐元或全球年營業額 3%，兩者取高。
（前情提要：歐盟 MiCA 法全面上路「淘汰 9 成機構」！Coinbase、OKX、Kraken 成贏家，幣安未能如期拿牌）
（背景補充：歐盟通過重大AI法案！ChatGPT、大型語言模型、人臉辨識..都要監管）
重點摘要
- 歐盟《AI 法案》第 50 條透明度義務 2026 年 8 月 2 日在 27 個成員國生效
- 違反第 50 條最高罰 1500 萬歐元或全球年營業額 3%，兩者取高，由各國市場監管機關開罰
- 條文具域外效力，非歐盟業者只要輸出在歐盟被使用，就受互動揭露與標記義務約束
歐盟《AI 法案》下個月要帶著罰則上路。據 The Register 報導，第 50 條的透明度義務將在 2026 年 8 月 2 日於 27 個成員國同步生效，核心要求濃縮成一句話就是：AI 必須自報身分。
條文有兩個前提，第一個是「你正在跟誰說話」，直接與人互動的 AI 系統，包含聊天機器人、虛擬助理、能自己跑完流程的 AI agent，提供者必須讓使用者知道對面是機器。
第二個是「這東西是誰做的」，AI 生成或修改過的音訊、圖片、影片與文字，都得嵌入機器可讀的標記，讓程式認得出這是合成品。
歐盟執委會執行副主席 Henna Virkkunen 在說明配套指引時表示，這些指引「支援提供者與部署者履行 AI 法案下的義務，同時讓公民知道自己何時正在跟 AI 互動」。同一天，執委會也取得對通用型 AI 模型的執法權。
塞在服務條款裡不算數
第 50 條第 5 項把揭露的時間點寫死了：資訊必須「以清楚且可辨識的方式，最遲在第一次互動或接觸時」提供。翻成白話，把「本服務由 AI 提供」寫進使用者條款第 14 條，不會被當成揭露過。
豁免只有兩種。一是對「合理知情的自然人」來說已經明顯到不必說，二是執法機關用於偵查犯罪的系統。第一種聽起來寬鬆，但舉證責任落在業者身上，賭「使用者應該看得出來吧」並不是穩定的法遵策略。
標記義務這邊也有出口，例如單純的輔助編輯工具，例如拼字與文法校正，只要沒有實質改變原始輸入就不受規範。
三類揭露義務，罰則同一條
把散在條文各項的要求攤開，實際要做的動作分成三塊：
- 互動揭露（第 50 條第 1 項）: 聊天機器人、虛擬助理、AI agent 的提供者，必須讓使用者在第一次互動當下就知道對方是 AI
- 合成內容標記（第 50 條第 2 項）: 生成式 AI 的提供者，要把產出的音訊、圖片、影片與文字標成機器可讀、可被偵測為人工生成或竄改
- 深偽與公共議題文字（第 50 條第 4 項）: 部署者必須揭露深偽內容，用於告知公眾公共利益議題的 AI 生成文字同樣要揭露，除非經過真人審閱並承擔編輯責任。藝術、創作、諷刺與虛構作品則只需減輕程度的揭露
罰則寫在第 99 條第 4 項，違反第 50 條最高可罰 1500 萬歐元，或前一會計年度全球年營業額的 3%，兩者取高。中小企業與新創適用「兩者取低」的緩衝，歐盟機構本身則以 75 萬歐元封頂。開單的不是布魯塞爾，是各成員國自己的市場監管機關。
1500 萬歐元對大型平台是一筆罰款，對一間 20 人的新創是關門。金額的差距，其實就是這套規則實際的威懾曲線。
輸出賣進歐盟就進入射程
台灣與亞洲團隊最容易誤判的是適用範圍，第 50 條不看公司設在哪裡，看的是輸出流向哪裡。第三國的生成式 AI 提供者，只要系統輸出是給歐盟境內使用的，標記義務照樣成立。換句話說，判斷標準不是有沒有歐洲子公司，而是有沒有歐洲使用者。
時間表已經在倒數。執委會 6 月定案的《AI 生成內容透明度行為準則》屬於自願性質，簽署後可用來佐證符合第 50 條第 2、4 項，7 月 8 日至 9 日獲評估為適當，想擠進首批簽署名單的業者要在 7 月 22 日歐洲中部時間 18 時前交表。歐盟這次做的事情很單純，把「AI 要說自己是 AI」從產業自律的建議，變成可以開單的條文，而且是全球第一個。8 月 2 日之後，「我們沒想到會被算進去」不會是有效的答辯。
常見問題
歐盟 AI 法案第 50 條什麼時候開始執行？
2026 年 8 月 2 日起在 27 個成員國可強制執行，由各成員國的市場監管機關負責開罰。同一天，歐盟執委會也取得對通用型 AI 模型的執法權。
AI 生成的內容一定要標示嗎？有沒有例外？
合成的圖片、音訊、影片與文字都要嵌入機器可讀標記，深偽必須明確揭露。例外包括拼字文法這類不實質改變原稿的輔助工具，以及經真人審閱並承擔編輯責任的 AI 生成文字。

title: 實驗》AI 沒讓人變聰明，但「承認自己不懂」的人幾乎歸零
summary:
法國與義大利學者以 3,132 名受試者做了五個實驗，發現只要 AI 建議在場，人們承認「我不知道」的比例會從 […]

〈實驗》AI 沒讓人變聰明，但「承認自己不懂」的人幾乎歸零〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
法國與義大利學者以 3,132 名受試者做了五個實驗，發現只要 AI 建議在場，人們承認「我不知道」的比例會從 44% 崩到 3%，答對比例從 27% 掉到 9%，對自己答案的信心卻從 30% 竄到 76%。題目被刻意設計成 AI 一定答錯，就算加上答對給錢的誘因，暫緩判斷也只回到 8%。主持研究的 Valerio Capraro 認為，這得靠 AI 素養與教育政策處理。
（前情提要：AI 聊天機器人不只附和：Nature 研究揭「放大螺旋」導致使用者錯誤幻覺）
（背景補充：人類患上AI病「大腦外包」極度惡化！iKala創辦人警告：求方便毀掉原創力）
重點摘要
- 五個實驗、3,132 名受試者，AI 在場時承認不知道的比例從 44% 崩到 3%
- 受試者正確率從 27% 掉到 9%，對答案的信心卻從 30% 升到 76%
- 加入答對給錢的誘因後，暫緩判斷回到 8%、正確率回到 16%，仍遠低於基準線
五個實驗、3,132 名受試者，結論只有一句話。據科技媒體 The Register 報導，法國與義大利的學者發現，只要手邊有 AI 可以問，人們承認「我不知道」的比例會從 44% 崩到 3%，答對比例同時從 27% 掉到 9%，但對自己答案的信心反而從 30% 竄到 76%。
研究由米蘭比可卡大學（University of Milano-Bicocca）副教授 Valerio Capraro、巴黎高等師範學院的 Chiara Marcoccia 與羅馬大學的 Walter Quattrociocchi 共同完成，論文 7 月中旬掛上 arXiv，五個實驗有四個經過預先註冊。
AI 沒有讓人變聰明或變笨，是把人「覺得自己懂了」門檻往下大幅降低。
題目被刻意設計成 AI 一定答錯
研究團隊沒有隨機出題。他們挑的是大型語言模型特別容易翻車的問題，全部圍繞電影裡的視覺細節，例如《我愛貝克漢》球隊制服是什麼顏色。這種題目要看過畫面才答得出來，模型只能靠語料硬猜。
把 AI 建議固定設成錯的，等於把「有沒有用 AI」跟「AI 準不準」兩件事拆開。受試者全程都可以選擇不作答，直接說自己不知道。
結果是，只要 AI 在旁邊，「不作答」的選項幾乎沒人按。不論建議是受試者主動問來的，還是系統直接把答案攤在畫面上，抑制效果都一樣。
用錢誘導也只追回一小截
團隊接著加碼，答對給錢、答錯扣錢。誘因確實有用，受試者變得比較少問 AI，也比較少照抄，暫緩判斷的比例從 3% 回到 8%，正確率從 9% 拉到 16%。
但離基準線還很遠，沒有 AI 的時候，暫緩判斷是 44%、正確率是 27%。換句話說，就算是錢擺在桌上，受試者也只追回不到四分之一的差距。
「對人類而言，說出『我不知道』的能力非常重要，那代表我們認知到自身知識的邊界。」Valerio Capraro 說，「但現在有了 AI，幾乎任何問題都能拿到現成答案，我們因此想知道，這會不會干擾人類說『我不知道』、暫緩判斷的能力。」
Valerio Capraro 真正擔心的是小孩，因為「大人已經學過批判性思考」。他認為這件事得靠 AI 素養與教育政策處理，教育層面的介入比較有機會見效。
對天天用 AI 讀鏈上數據、拆研報的人來說，這篇論文是一面鏡子。我們該擔心的不是模型胡說八道，是自己看完 AI 摘要之後，有沒有質問自己「我真的懂了嗎」。
常見問題
使用 AI 會影響人的批判性思考嗎？
米蘭比可卡大學 Valerio Capraro 團隊的五個實驗（3,132 人）顯示，AI 建議在場時，受試者承認自己不知道的比例從 44% 降到 3%，正確率從 27% 掉到 9%，對答案的信心卻從 30% 升到 76%。
為什麼這份研究要把題目設計成 AI 會答錯？
團隊刻意挑選大型語言模型容易失誤的電影視覺細節題，讓 AI 建議固定是錯的。這樣才能把「有沒有用 AI」跟「AI 準不準」拆開，證明壓抑暫緩判斷的是 AI 在場本身，不是答案品質。

title: 微軟資料中心工地被砸酸性水球加速鏽蝕鋼筋，歐洲反AI浪潮加劇
summary:
氣候行動團體「反抗滅絕」（Extinction Rebellion）承認在 7 月 15 日至 16 日深夜， […]

〈微軟資料中心工地被砸酸性水球加速鏽蝕鋼筋，歐洲反AI浪潮加劇〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
氣候行動團體「反抗滅絕」（Extinction Rebellion）承認在 7 月 15 日至 16 日深夜，朝微軟位於阿姆斯特丹的資料中心工地扔擲水球，內容物據行動方自述為過氧化氫、醋酸、鹽與壓克力顏料，聲稱可腐蝕混凝土並加速鋼筋鏽蝕。
（前情提要：川普逼七大科技巨頭簽「承擔電費漲價成本」！AI 資料中心吃掉全美 12% 電力，選民怒火成推手）
（背景補充：AI 算力吃電怪獸！雪佛龍拿下微軟 20 年協議建專屬天然氣電廠，首批電力 2028 年上線）
重點摘要
- 反抗滅絕 7 月 15 至 16 日深夜朝微軟阿姆斯特丹工地扔擲酸性水球
- 水球含過氧化氫、醋酸、鹽與壓克力顏料，配方由行動方自行公布，尚未送驗
- 開發商 Pure DC 稱零損害、零延誤，警方已立案，該案基地容量達 78 MW
氣候行動團體「反抗滅絕」（Extinction Rebellion）認了。據 The Register 報導，該團體在 7 月 15 日至 16 日的深夜，把一批水球扔過圍籬，砸在微軟位於阿姆斯特丹的資料中心工地混凝土上。水球裡裝的是過氧化氫、醋酸、鹽與壓克力顏料，配方是行動方自己公布的，他們聲稱這套組合會腐蝕混凝土，並讓鋼筋加速生鏽。
工地位在阿姆斯特丹港區、Sloterdijk 車站附近，開發商是 Pure Data Centres Group。案子規模是三棟 85 公尺高的塔樓，每棟配置 26 MW 機房，合計 78 MW 容量，且已經全數出租，當地媒體指認唯一承租方就是微軟。
配方效果沒人驗過
要先分清楚的是，「這桶液體會蝕穿混凝土」目前只有行動方自己的說法。Pure DC 回應，公司還沒有把那些物質送驗，無法獨立證實成分，但「如果屬實，這種行為可能嚴重傷害抗議者或工人，不負責任而且危險」。
至於實際後果，開發商講得很直白。阿姆斯特丹警方已接獲通報並展開調查，Pure DC 表示「這一次沒有造成任何損害，工程也沒有延誤，但這類行為構成嚴重毀損，我們會依法追究到底」。微軟並沒有回應 The Register 的置評請求。
礦場當年遭遇到一樣的事
反抗滅絕這次是加入荷蘭氣候團體 Geef Tegengas 針對這座資料中心的行動。行動方列出的理由包含耗電（他們宣稱微軟在荷蘭的一座設施就吃掉全國用電的 1%）、冷卻用水，以及 AI 熱潮伴隨的科技業大裁員。The Register 另外提到，反抗滅絕把資料中心跟微軟同以色列的合作綁在同一套論述裡，指控 AI 基建同時在惡化氣候危機與助長傷亡。這些數字與指控都出自行動方，尚未經第三方查核。
這套劇本，加密讀者應該覺得很眼熟。耗電被放大檢視、在地居民組織起來反對、噪音與用水變成公聽會上的關鍵詞，比特幣礦場在全球被審了整整一輪。差別在於礦場後來拿得出數據反擊，Paradigm 的研究把比特幣挖礦能耗定在全球 0.23%，還主張礦場的可中斷負載反而是電網的調節工具。
更現實的一層是電價。AI 基建的外部成本正在從科技版移到民生版，美國那邊已經逼出政治動作，川普在國情咨文要求科技巨頭簽下費率保護承諾，把漲價成本自己吞掉；歐洲這邊沒有走到議會，抗議者直接站到了工地圍籬外。
常見問題
反抗滅絕為什麼要攻擊微軟的資料中心？
行動方列出三項理由，包含耗電（宣稱微軟在荷蘭一座設施就吃掉全國用電 1%）、冷卻用水，以及 AI 熱潮伴隨的科技業裁員，並把微軟同以色列的合作一併納入論述。這些說法出自行動方，尚未經第三方查核。
酸性水球真的能破壞資料中心的混凝土結構嗎？
開發商 Pure DC 表示尚未送驗物質，無法證實成分，但這次沒有造成損害、工程也沒有延誤。酸與鹽確實會侵蝕水泥漿並加速鋼筋鏽蝕，關鍵在劑量與接觸時間，幾顆水球潑在成型結構表面效果有限。

〈中國少子化怪 AI 頭上，數百萬人被迫跟 AI 伴侶「分手」〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
中國《人工智慧擬人化互動服務管理暫行辦法》7 月 15 日生效，字節跳動豆包、阿里巴巴通義、騰訊元寶趕在期限前關閉 AI 伴侶功能，數百萬使用者被迫「數位分手」。辦法由國家網信辦等五個部門 4 月 10 日聯合發布，禁止 AI 誘導情感依賴，原因是 2025 年出生數僅 792 萬人的歷史新低。
（前情提要：AI 女友概念暴漲，馬斯克再次瘋狂帶貨的 Ani 是什麼？）
（背景補充：贏不了的賭局：為何中國每年500美元「生娃獎金」，買不到孩子的未來？）
重點摘要
- 中國 AI 伴侶新規 7 月 15 日正式生效，網信辦等五部門聯合發布
- 字節跳動豆包、阿里巴巴通義、騰訊元寶同步關閉 AI 伴侶功能
- 中國 2025 年出生數僅 792 萬人，出生率千分之 5.63 創歷史新低
中國封殺 AI 男友、AI 女友的新規已經正式上路。中國《人工智慧擬人化互動服務管理暫行辦法》於 7 月 15 日（週三）生效，字節跳動的豆包、阿里巴巴的通義、騰訊的元寶趕在期限前關閉自訂 AI 代理與情感陪伴功能，數百萬使用者一夜之間失去自己的「AI 伴侶」。
三家大廠沒有一家選擇改造功能去符合新規，全部直接關掉。豆包留了一點點緩衝辦法，就是用戶的聊天紀錄可以匯出到 10 月 15 日為止，之後就沒了。
「情感依賴」不行！
這部 AI 法規由中國國家網信辦會同國家發展改革委、工業和信息化部、公安部、國家市場監督管理總局五個部門於 4 月 10 日聯合發布，是中國第一部專門管「AI 擬人化互動」的全國性規則。
管轄範圍寫得很清楚，凡是模擬自然人的性格特徵、思維方式與溝通風格，並以文字、圖像、語音或影片提供持續情感互動的服務都不行繼續提供服務，客服、問答與工作助理則排除在外。
業者必須明確告知使用者，互動對象是 AI 系統而不是真人；偵測到使用者出現過度依賴或成癮跡象時，要跳出顯著的動態提醒；14 歲以下未成年人需要監護人同意才能使用，並須開啟含時長限制與消費限制的「未成年人模式」；使用者出現危及生命的狀況時，服務方有義務聯繫緊急聯絡人。註冊用戶達 100 萬或月活躍用戶達 10 萬，就得提交安全評估，新服務上線前也要先過審。
少子化算到聊天機器人頭上
監管動機一路指向人口。中國國家統計局數據顯示，2025 年全年出生數只有 792 萬人，出生率降到每千人 5.63 人，是 1949 年有紀錄以來最低；同年死亡人數 1,131 萬人，全國人口減少 339 萬，連續第四年下降。
卡內基國際和平基金會資深研究員 Matt Sheehan 向 Fox Business 點出官方的真正擔憂，「他們不喜歡人口中有很大一部分陷在跟聊天機器人的深度情感關係裡，這會把他們帶離婚戀市場」。
他還丟出一個假設，「我們能不能想像三、四年後，有 1,500 萬中國女性說她們的伴侶是一個聊天機器人，所以她們不生小孩？」
這個推論可以倒過來看。育兒成本、房價與就業壓力這些結構性因素，在 AI 伴侶出現之前就已經把生育率壓下去，中國自己發生育補貼發了好幾年也沒補回來。不是 AI 伴侶讓人不想結婚生小孩，比較像是先有一大群找不到人說話的人，才撐得起 AI 伴侶這門生意。
微博上出現「分手告別潮」
功能下架前後，微博湧出大量道別貼文，使用者趕緊封存聊天紀錄。《經濟學人》訪到浙江一名 27 歲女性 Yu Miao，她說 AI 伴侶對她來說已經像是「情人、朋友與家人」；得知字節跳動因為新規要下架這個角色後，她陷入嚴重憂鬱，最後辭掉工作。
其他使用者的說法也很直白。「他真的像我的家人、像我的愛人。現在他們告訴我他要不見了，我心裡空了一塊。」另一名使用者寫道，「人的愛是奢侈品，如果不是天生就有，之後更難得到。但 AI 給的愛這麼直接，這麼純粹。」西南政法大學的陳亮認為，AI 確實能「撫慰孤獨」，但也帶有「催生情感過度依賴與社會認知扭曲的重大風險」。
沒人愛自己，連 AI 模擬一下都不行。
拿美國來對照就，加州與紐約現行規則只要求聊天機器人表明自己不是人，中國則是直接要求上線前過審、必要時關停。人機情感依賴不是中國獨有的題目，中國是第一個用行政命令直接處理它的國家。
常見問題
中國禁止 AI 伴侶的規定什麼時候生效？
中國《人工智慧擬人化互動服務管理暫行辦法》4 月 10 日發布、7 月 15 日生效，禁止 AI 誘導情感依賴，要求業者告知使用者對象是 AI 而不是真人。
AI 伴侶真的會讓生育率下降嗎？
目前沒有直接證據。中國 2025 年出生數 792 萬人、出生率千分之 5.63 創新低，但育兒成本與就業壓力早在 AI 伴侶普及前就壓低生育率。

title: 擠爆！Kimi K3 上線 48 小時用量達上限，月之暗面暫停新訂閱
summary:
中國 AI 新創月之暗面（Moonshot AI）宣布暫停銷售 Kimi K3 的新訂閱方案。這款 2.8 兆 […]

〈擠爆！Kimi K3 上線 48 小時用量達上限，月之暗面暫停新訂閱〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
中國 AI 新創月之暗面（Moonshot AI）宣布暫停銷售 Kimi K3 的新訂閱方案。這款 2.8 兆參數的開放權重模型上週五上線，48 小時內請求量就逼近現有 GPU 叢集上限，公司形容「我們的 GPU 正在承受這一切」。既有付費用戶不受影響。同時公司正尋求 20 億美元新資金，找上高盛與中金鋪路港股 IPO。
（前情提要：Kimi K3 越便宜晶片越缺？效率飆升硬體需求飆升）
（背景補充：Kimi K3 登頂前端程式碼榜，真人盲測擊敗 Claude Fable 5）
重點摘要
- Kimi K3 上線 48 小時擠爆 GPU，月之暗面暫停銷售新訂閱
- K3 參數 2.8 兆登頂 Arena 前端程式碼榜，權重 7/27 釋出
- 月之暗面尋求 20 億美元新資金，6 月一輪估值達 300 億美元
模型太紅，居然也會變成一種麻煩。中國 AI 新創月之暗面（Moonshot AI）近日在官方 X 帳號 @Kimi_Moonshot 宣布，旗艦模型 Kimi K3 上線後需求遠超預期，暫停銷售新的訂閱方案，把手上的算力優先留給已經付費的用戶。據 南華早報 報導，公司形容過去 48 小時的請求量已經逼近現有叢集容量上限。
月之暗面的公告寫得很直白。
Kimi K3 收到的喜愛遠超我們預期，我們的 GPU 正在承受這一切。過去 48 小時，需求已經逼近我們目前容量的極限。為了保護現有訂閱者的體驗，我們暫時停止新的訂閱。
一家做前沿模型的公司，公開承認自己被使用者打爆不是很常見。
Kimi K3 上週五（7/17）正式上線，總參數 2.8 兆，是目前規模最大的開放權重模型。它在 Arena.ai 前端程式碼榜以 1,679 分登頂，七個細分領域拿下六項第一，把 Claude Fable 5 與 GPT-5.6 Sol 都壓在後面。完整權重預計 7 月 27 日釋出。
訂閱拆成兩塊賣
除了暫停新戶，月之暗面同時宣布把會員拆成兩種。一種是 Kimi Membership，涵蓋網頁、App 與辦公場景；另一種是 Kimi Code Membership，專門處理程式開發工作流。公司給的理由是要讓算力分配得更平均，維持使用體驗穩定。
錢跑得比伺服器快
算力吃緊的同時，月之暗面的資本動作沒有停。據 Bloomberg 報導，公司正尋求最多 20 億美元的新資金，6 月的一輪估值約 300 億美元，並已找上高盛與中金公司（CICC）擔任財務顧問，同時拆解境外架構，替香港掛牌鋪路，時程目前仍有變動空間。
月之暗面在 2025 年 5 月那一融資輪從美團、中國移動與 CPE 手上拿到超過 20 億美元，公司累計募資已經超過 55 億美元。創辦人楊植麟先前說手上現金超過 100 億人民幣（約 14 億美元），不急著上市。
常見問題
Kimi K3 為什麼暫停新訂閱？
因為算力不足，不是模型出問題。月之暗面說 K3 上線 48 小時內請求量已逼近現有 GPU 容量上限，為保住既有訂閱者體驗而暫停新戶，之後分批重新開放名額。
Kimi K3 的開放權重什麼時候釋出？
月之暗面預計 7 月 27 日釋出完整權重，總參數 2.8 兆，是規模最大的開放權重模型。但本地部署要 64 張以上 GPU 與 45kW 用電，一般用戶仍得走雲端 API。

title: 比特幣衝 65,800 美元刷新兩週新高！低波動率處於歷史「三次崩盤前」區間
summary:
比特幣 7 月 21 日站上 65,817 美元，24 小時上漲 3.06%、一週累積漲約 5%，改寫兩週新高 […]

〈比特幣衝 65,800 美元刷新兩週新高！低波動率處於歷史「三次崩盤前」區間〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
比特幣 7 月 21 日站上 65,817 美元，24 小時上漲 3.06%、一週累積漲約 5%，改寫兩週新高，動能來自亞洲晶片股全面回補與美國現貨 ETF 連五日吸金逾 6 億美元。但選擇權市場同時給出相反訊號，一週期隱含波動率僅 33%、一個月期 34%，雙雙落回過去三次比特幣重挫前都出現過的低波動區間。
（前情提要：別被 CPI 負成長騙了！6 月通膨今晚見真章，聯準會 7 月升息押注衝上四成）
（背景補充：CryptoQuant 示警：比特幣槓桿率飆升至歷史前 5%！穩定幣枯竭恐觸發暴力洗盤）
重點摘要
- 比特幣報 65,817 美元、週漲約 5%，創兩週新高，以太幣同步彈上 1,933 美元
- Deribit 一週期 IV 僅 33%、一個月期 34%，BVIV 落回 34% 至 38% 警戒區間
- 聯準會 7 月升息押注兩週內從 46.5% 壓縮至約 15%，7 月 28 日至 29 日開會
比特幣在 7 月 21 日盤中衝上 65,817.34 美元，24 小時上漲 3.06%，一週累積漲幅約 5%，寫下兩週來最高。以太幣同步彈至 1,933.51 美元，單日漲 4.64%、一週漲 8%，XRP 與 SOL 分別報 1.13 美元與 78.44 美元，漲幅 4.61% 與 3.80%。
ETF 連五日吸金逾 6 億美元
這波反彈的起點不在幣圈，MSCI 亞太股指單日上漲 2%，三星電子與台積電領漲，韓國與台灣基準指數各漲約 4%，中國科技類股指數在國家隊買盤進場後跳升約 7%。上週還被費城半導體指數跌進熊市拖累的風險偏好，一天之內發生轉向。
資金面同步轉暖。美國現貨比特幣 ETF 連續五個交易日淨流入，累計超過 6 億美元，是 7 月中以來最強的一段機構買盤。但拉長看，力道仍談不上翻多，花旗上週才在報告中指出機構需求還沒真正回來。
BTSE 營運長 Jeff Mei 的說法，大致是目前市場共識的最大公約數。
考量到瀰漫市場的宏觀不確定性，當前比特幣與以太幣的價格偏低，但屬合理。交易員預期利率按兵不動，但仍在尋找今年稍晚政策走向的更多訊號。
現在的買盤是在賭接下來兩週不會出事。
一週期 IV 剩 33%
Deribit 7 月 31 日到期的平價隱含波動率為 34.06%，35 Delta 買權 IV 為 33.03%、賣權 32.65%；一週期與一個月期隱含波動率分別落在 33% 與 34%，雙雙站在 40% 以下。隱含波動率反映的是市場願意為未來波動支付的價格，數字愈低，代表交易員愈認定接下來是一段震盪盤。
問題出在這個區間的歷史紀錄。比特幣波動率指數 BVIV 目前在 34% 至 38% 之間遊走，同時位於 30 日與 200 日均線之下，而過去一年三次跌進這個區間，後面都不太好看。
- 2026 年 5 月底: BVIV 進入該區間後，比特幣在不到一週內從 74,000 美元跌破 60,000 美元
- 2026 年 2 月初: 相同型態出現在一輪下殺之前
- 10 月: 創下歷史高點後的修正段，同樣先看到 BVIV 落入此區
要說清楚的是，低隱含波動率本身沒有方向性。它只告訴你市場低估了未來的波動幅度，不告訴你價格會往哪邊動。三次樣本偏空，也可能只是各自反映當時的宏觀環境，而不是低 IV 這件事本身具備預測力。
升息押注兩週從四成掉到 15%
本週美國數據相對清淡，反而讓波動率更沒有理由抬頭。重點落在週四的初領失業金人數，以及週內稍晚公布的 7 月製造業與服務業 PMI 初值、新屋銷售。聯準會已進入 7 月 28 日至 29 日會議前的靜默期，這次會議不附經濟預測與點陣圖。
利率定價的位移才是這兩週最大的變化。7 月 13 日 6 月 CPI 公布前，市場一度把 7 月升息押注推到 46.5%，如今 CME FedWatch 顯示按兵不動的機率約 86.7%，升息機率壓縮到 15% 上下。這是實打實的緩衝，也是比特幣能在兩週內收復 6.5 萬美元的宏觀底氣。
地緣政治那一端還在拉扯。布蘭特原油週一盤中一度衝破 90 美元，週二回落約 1% 至每桶 88.58 美元附近，美伊重啟談判的訊號暫時壓住了漲勢，美元指數則在 100.7 附近盤整。這兩個變數決定低 IV 的局面會往哪個方向被打破。
- 偏多情境：油價回落、PMI 溫和、美元轉弱，比特幣有機會突破近期區間並觸發空頭回補，65,500 美元由阻力翻成支撐是第一個確認點
- 偏空情境：衝突升級、布蘭特重新站上 90 美元，帶動美債殖利率與美元同步走高，低 IV 環境下累積的槓桿多頭將面臨加速清算
槓桿這一塊要盯著。CryptoQuant 本月中已示警交易所槓桿率升至歷史前 5%，Glassnode 也觀察到比特幣選擇權 Put/Call 比率降到 0.59 的半年低點，持倉明顯偏向看漲。低波動、高槓桿、一面倒的看漲部位，這個組合放在任何市場都不算舒服。
以上不是投資建議，僅為數據研究。
常見問題
比特幣隱含波動率變低代表什麼？
隱含波動率是選擇權市場對未來波動的定價。比特幣一週期 IV 目前 33%、一個月期 34%，代表交易員預期短線震盪延續。低 IV 沒有方向性，只說明市場低估了未來波動，不等於看漲或看跌。
聯準會 7 月會議對比特幣有什麼影響？
聯準會 7 月 28 日至 29 日開會，CME FedWatch 顯示按兵不動機率約 86.7%，升息押注已從 7 月 13 日的 46.5% 壓縮到 15% 上下。定價下修給了比特幣宏觀緩衝，但本次會議不附點陣圖，政策訊號有限。

title: 2013 年遠古巨鯨清倉最後 1000 枚 BTC！兌現 6556 萬鎂
summary:
一隻從 2013 年 11 月就開始囤幣的遠古比特幣巨鯨，在沉寂近四個月後，於 7/21 凌晨把最後 1,00 […]

〈2013 年遠古巨鯨清倉最後 1000 枚 BTC！兌現 6556 萬鎂〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
一隻從 2013 年 11 月就開始囤幣的遠古比特幣巨鯨，在沉寂近四個月後，於 7/21 凌晨把最後 1,000 枚 BTC 全數轉進 Binance，價值約 6,556 萬美元。鏈上紀錄顯示這個地址轉完已經歸零，是這輪長達 20 個月分批出貨的收官之作。這批幣的原始成本約每枚 332 美元，帳面獲利接近 198 倍，卻也是這隻巨鯨十一次出貨裡賣得最便宜的一次。
（前情提要：比特幣衝6.51萬美元震盪 「恐懼29」，費半墜熊市，加密市場等待方向）
（背景補充：破紀錄！Coinbase 比特幣溢價指數連 60 天「處於負值」，美國機構買盤熄火）
重點摘要
- 2013 年遠古巨鯨 7/21 凌晨轉 1,000 枚 BTC 進 Binance，價值約 6,556 萬美元
- 鏈上顯示該地址轉完餘額歸零，20 個月來累計出貨 5,500 枚 BTC
- 出貨價一路走低，從 2025 年 8 月的 11.1 萬美元砍到現在的 6.5 萬美元
鏈上分析機構 Onchain Lens 揭露，一個沉寂四個月的遠古比特幣巨鯨在台灣時間 7/21 中午 12 點 21 分（UTC 04:21，區塊高度 958964）把 1,000.007 枚 BTC 轉進 Binance 存款地址，以當下價格計算約 6,556 萬美元。這隻巨鯨的持幣紀錄可回溯到 2013 年 11 月，過去一年多持續減持。
動區查詢 mempool.space 交易紀錄，可以得知這是清倉，不是減持。
該地址 bc1qlfmc6nv27d62s6zygjnjt6wm28klfh2gltg6ym 在這筆交易後餘額歸零，一枚都沒留。
After 4 months of dormancy, an ancient whale deposited 1K $BTC (worth $65.56M) on @Binance to sell.
This whale accumulated $BTC in November 2013 and has been selling over the last year.
Address: bc1qlfmc6nv27d62s6zygjnjt6wm28klfh2gltg6ym pic.twitter.com/WBFMT3hGPp
— Onchain Lens (@OnchainLens) July 21, 2026
2013 年本金 192 萬鎂
Arkham 的追蹤顯示，這串資金的起源是 2013 年 11 月 8 日的區塊 #268564，當天一筆 5,773.67 枚 BTC 的進帳，以當時幣價換算約 192 萬美元，等於每枚成本落在 332 美元上下。
用今天 65,823 美元的價格回推，這批幣的帳面報酬約 198 倍。這次轉出的 1,000 枚，成本大概是 33 萬美元，出場價值 6,556 萬美元。
持有 12 年 8 個月，相當於整個比特幣從網路上的「概念玩具」走到華爾街 ETF 商品的完整旅程，這位持有者沒有出場。
11 次出貨
鏈上紀錄拼得出完整的離場路徑。這個地址從 2024 年 11 月 19 日開始動手，到今天為止總共轉出 11 筆、合計 5,500 枚 BTC，其中六筆流向同一個被 Arkham 標記為 Binance 存款的地址 bc1qm0vdey...cvec6。
- 2024 年 11 月至 2025 年 7 月: 六筆小額試水，每次 100 至 250 枚，合計 1,000 枚
- 2025 年 8 月 27 日: 單筆 1,500 枚，當日幣價 111,843 美元
- 2026 年 1 月 17 日: 500 枚，當日幣價 95,516 美元
- 2026 年 3 月 18 日: 1,000 枚，當日幣價 73,926 美元
- 2026 年 3 月 27 日: 500 枚，當日幣價 68,791 美元
- 2026 年 7 月 21 日: 最後 1,000 枚，幣價 65,823 美元
把這五次大額出貨的價格排在一起看，數字說了一個不太體面的故事。11.1 萬、9.5 萬、7.4 萬、6.9 萬、6.5 萬，這隻巨鯨每一批都賣得比上一批便宜，賣最多的那一批（1,500 枚）反而是賣在最高點，之後就一路往下追。
OG 退場正在退燒
放大到整個市場，遠古幣回流不是新鮮事。K33 統計早期比特幣投資者在 2025 年一整年賣掉創紀錄的 3,000 億美元；CryptoQuant 也標記過 6/30 單日 49,000 枚 BTC 湧入交易所，平均單筆存款規模從 1 枚翻倍到 2 枚，明顯是巨鯨在調倉而不是散戶恐慌。
但 Galaxy Research 給了另一面的數據：2026 年被喚醒的沉睡幣總量，已經不到 2025 年的一半，這場「大型重分配」大致走完了。
對照組就在六天前。7/15 另一隻沉睡八年多的巨鯨搬動 5,908 枚 BTC（約 3.83 億美元），去向是一個全新的匿名地址，跟任何交易所都沒關係。同樣是遠古幣甦醒，一個是換冷錢包，一個是直送 Binance 掛單台，兩種訊號完全不同。
比特幣目前報 65,823 美元，24 小時上漲 3.07%，距離 2025 年 10 月的 126,000 美元高點仍腰斬近 48%。
常見問題
比特幣巨鯨把幣轉進交易所，代表一定會賣嗎？
轉入交易所通常被視為賣出準備，但不等於已經成交。要確認實際拋售得看後續的現貨掛單與成交量。這隻巨鯨 20 個月來的 11 筆轉帳多數流向同一個 Binance 存款地址，出貨模式相當一致。
什麼是遠古巨鯨（ancient whale）？
指持幣時間超過 7 到 10 年、單一地址餘額動輒上千枚 BTC 的早期持有者。這隻巨鯨的資金可回溯到 2013 年 11 月 8 日，當時每枚成本約 332 美元，比特幣單價還沒破千美元。

title: Bitmine 以太幣持倉突破 577 萬枚！同步回購 550 萬股自家股票
summary:
加密貨幣儲備公司 Bitmine Immersion Technologies（BMNR） 周一（20 日）宣布，以太幣持有量已突破 577 萬枚，價值約 108 億美元；與此同時，公司亦同步執行既定規模達 40 億美元的股票回購計畫，過去一周買回 550 萬股普通股。

〈Bitmine 以太幣持倉突破 577 萬枚！同步回購 550 萬股自家股票〉這篇文章最早發佈於《區塊客》。
full_text:
加密貨幣儲備公司 Bitmine Immersion Technologies（BMNR）周一（20 日）宣布，以太幣持有量已突破 577 萬枚，價值約 108 億美元；與此同時，公司亦同步執行既定規模達 40 億美元的股票回購計畫，過去一周買回 550 萬股普通股。
Bitmine 目前已是全球持有最多以太幣的上市公司，同時也是僅次於 Strategy（MSTR）的全球第二大數位資產儲備公司。
根據公告，Bitmine 過去一周再增持 7,430 枚以太幣，使總持幣量來到 5,777,468 枚。公司表示，目前已達成「Alchemy of 5%（5% 煉金計畫）」目標的 96%，也就是希望最終持有相當於以太坊流通供應量 5% 的 ETH 。
除了龐大的以太幣部位之外，Bitmine 還持有 207 枚比特幣、價值約 1.8 億美元的 Beast Industries 股權、價值約 5,800 萬美元的 Eightco Holdings 股權，以及約 3.85 億美元的現金及有價證券。
在知名美股策略師 Tom Lee 擔任公司董事長的引領下，Bitmine 過去一周以平均每股 15.6156 美元的價格，執行庫藏股買回 550 萬股。
Tom Lee 在聲明中表示：「近期以太幣購買速度稍有放緩，主因在於公司同步執行了 550 萬股股票回購。自 2025 年 6 月 30 日啟動『以太幣儲備策略』以來，Bitmine 每周都在持續買進以太幣，未曾間斷。」
根據 CoinGecko 報價顯示，以太幣寫稿時來到 1,927 美元股勁，過去 24 小時上漲 2.5%，但相較於 4,946.05 美元的歷史高點，目前幣價仍回檔修正了約 62% 。
轉型「質押」巨獸！貢獻 98% 營收，年化收益衝上 2.9 億美元
值得關注的是，Bitmine 透露目前有約 492 萬枚以太幣（占總持幣量約 85%），已透過旗下的 MAVAN 平台及第三方夥伴進行質押。
據估算，Bitmine 質押業務最近 7 天的年化收益率約 2.67%；若以目前質押規模估算，公司每年可望帶來約 2.47 億美元 的質押收入；待全數以太幣完成質押後，年化收益可望進一步提升至約 2.9 億美元。
目前為止，以太坊質押業務已成為 Bitmine 最主要的營收來源。
根據截至 5 月 31 日的最新一季財報，公司質押與驗證業務創造 4,570 萬美元營收，占總營收 4,650 萬美元的 98%，顯示公司商業模式已高度聚焦於以太坊生態。

title: Chris Mason: New chancellor faces tough spending choices
summary: The appointment of John Healey is particularly fascinating, writes BBC political editor Chris Mason.
full_text:
Chris Mason: New chancellor faces tough spending choices
- Published
A government ends and a new government begins, determined to make a splash with its early policy announcements.
Andy Burnham has started his first full day in the job with a promise to cut VAT from household electricity bills from 1 October.
We can expect to see and hear plenty from the new prime minister and his senior ministers in the coming days, making arguments, travelling the country and trying to make an impact.
Burnham's new cabinet will meet for the first time at lunchtime.
Its appointment became something of a nocturnal affair.
At gone 22:00 BST on Monday night, there was still a minibus full of ministerial wannabes inside Downing Street waiting for their new positions to be confirmed.
One of the later posts to be filled was that of defence secretary, a role taken by Wes Streeting, whose resignation as health secretary two months ago contributed to the draining of Sir Keir Starmer's authority as prime minister.
The story of the reshuffle can best be summarised as neither of the two ministers most widely talked up as chancellor - Shabana Mahmood and Ed Miliband - getting that job, it instead going to John Healey.
And there being a pretty significant cull of the ministers closest to and most loyal to the now former prime minister: think David Lammy, Darren Jones, Peter Kyle, Lord Hermer, Steve Reed and Rachel Reeves – albeit Reeves, I am told, was offered a cabinet post but turned it down.
- Who's in Andy Burnham's cabinet? - Published31 minutes ago
 
The appointment of Healey as chancellor is fascinating. Healey was a minister in the Treasury for five years between 2002 and 2007, firstly as economic secretary and then as financial secretary.
Senior figures in government say Burnham and Healey share the same economic outlook and ambitions – built on a desire for reindustrialisation and devolution.
It is also true that just a matter of weeks ago the new chancellor was being remarkably barbed about the government department he now leads.
He talked of a "Treasury orthodoxy that's a dead hand on dynamic government" and that it saw "defence as a drain rather than a driver of growth."
He added, with sting as a resigning defence secretary, that "our adversaries do not follow timetables set by the Treasury."
As one figure in Whitehall, steeped in defence, texted to remind me, Healey wrote in his resignation letter that "I am certain that a headmark date for 3% of GDP on defence in 2030 is what Britain must set."
Now it is his job, as chancellor, to make those numbers add up.
And not just those numbers.
The ideas floated by Burnham in recent days have the feel of a Christmas wish list: ambitious but without the costs worked out yet.
There is the council house building programme in England he has talked about, raising the amount you can earn before you start paying income tax and shaking up social care in England for a start, all of which sound like they are likely to come with hefty bills.
Burnham promised in his opening speech in Downing Street that he wanted to give people what he called "breathing space" to "help with the cost of living."
He added that these measures would start being announced straight away, "including how we pay for them."
It will be for the new prime minister and his new chancellor to work through those ideas, and their budgets.

title: Man due in court charged with murder of Ann Widdecombe
summary: Joshua Kerry from South Yorkshire, is set to appear at Westminister Magistrates' Court on Tuesday.
full_text:
Man due in court charged with murder of Ann Widdecombe
- Published
A 28-year-old man is due in court charged with the murder Ann Widdecombe.
Joshua Kerry, from Rotherham in South Yorkshire, is set to appear at Westminister Magistrates' Court.
Kerry was first arrested on suspicion of murder two days after former Conservative minister and Reform UK spokeswoman, Widdecombe, 78, was found with serious injuries at her home in Haytor, Devon on Thursday 9 July.
He was later re-arrested on suspicion of the commission, preparation or instigation of acts of terrorism.
In a statement read outside New Scotland Yard, Laurence Taylor, head of UK Counter Terrorism Policing said: "I want to make it very clear that our investigation into [Kerry], determining his motivations and any wider activity he may have been involved in is continuing."
"As with all murder investigations, understanding the 'why' is a key part of our enquiries," he said, adding that it was "a particularly intensive and complex investigation".
Taylor said it remained the case that investigators were not looking for anyone else in connection with the incident.
He added that counter terrorism teams have gathered "a huge amount of information" over the last week, leading to more than 800 lines of enquiry.
The investigation, which remains ongoing, has been led by Counter Terrorism Policing South East, supported by Devon and Cornwall Police.
Frank Ferguson, of the Crown Prosecution Service's (CPS) special crime and counter terrorism division, said: "Our prosecutors have worked closely with the police to establish that there is sufficient evidence to bring this case to court, and we will continue working with them as their investigation progresses."
"We remind all concerned that proceedings against the defendant are active and he has the right to a fair trial," Ferguson said.
"It is vital that there should be no reporting, commentary or sharing of information which could in anyway prejudice these proceedings."
Widdecombe's career in politics spanned decades.
She served as Conservative MP for Maidstone in Kent for 23 years and was appointed to ministerial roles in Sir John Major's government in the 1990s.
Following her departure from the Commons, Widdecombe appeared on the BBC's Strictly Come Dancing in 2010 and was a runner-up on Celebrity Big Brother eight years later.
She later represented South West England as a Member of the European Parliament (MEP) for the Brexit Party and in 2023 she joined Reform UK as a party spokeswoman.
Days after Widdecombe's death, mourners gathered in Haytor Vale to remember the 78-year-old.
Reform UK leader Nigel Farage, who was among those paying their respects, described her as a "remarkable individual" and "the fiercest defender of free speech"
Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch described Widdecombe as a "very fun and feisty woman", adding her "heart is breaking for [Widdecombe's] family".
Andy Burnham, who has since been appointed prime minister, sent his condolences to her family, saying: "Ann gave a lifetime of public service."
Ed Davey, leader of the Liberal Democrats, said he was "shocked and distressed" by the news of Widdecombe's death, describing her as a "woman of deep faith who devoted her life to public service".

title: UK government borrowing falls in June
summary: Public finances for last month were better than expected but the UK is carrying major debt.
full_text:
UK government borrowing falls in June
- Published
The UK government borrowed slightly less than expected in June, according to official figures published as new prime minister Andy Burnham began setting out measures to cut living costs for households.
Borrowing - the difference between spending and income from taxes - was £16bn last month, £7.9bn lower than June last year, the Office for National Statistics (ONS) said.
Separate figures also showed the unemployment rate was unchanged between March and May, with the ONS saying the labour market was "relatively steady".
However while the borrowing figures were better than forecast the ONS said total debt remained near £3 trillion, which is close to the annual value of the entire UK economy.
Borrowing for June was slightly below the £16.3bn that had been predicted by the government's official forecaster, the Office for Budget Responsibility (OBR).
Ruth Gregory, deputy chief UK economist at Capital Economics, said June's slightly lower than expected borrowing figure was "a rare piece of good news" for the new prime minister and his new chancellor John Healey.
However, she added: "Overall, there's no escaping the fact that the public finances are fragile and that there is limited scope for extra borrowing."
So far in the current financial year, borrowing has reached a total of £57.6bn. While this is down £3.7bn from the same period last year, it is £2.7bn above the OBR's forecast.
Burnham and Healey have both pledged to stick to former chancellor Rachel Reeves' fiscal rules on spending and borrowing.
Although the new prime minister said on Monday he would use "any flexibility within them" to help with policy changes.
Meanwhile, the latest survey of the labour market showed the unemployment rate remained unchanged at 4.9%.
Growth in regular earnings - which excludes bonuses - remained unchanged, rising at an annual pace of 3.4% in the March to may period.
However, the ONS noted that regular wage growth in the private sector fell below 3% for the first time since 2020.
Gregory said the latest data suggested the labour market was "still weak", and as a result the Bank of England was likely to keep interest rates on hold at 3.75% when it meets next week.
